source: https://dicardcuracao.com/portal, https://dicardcuracao.com/dicard/ and https://www.curacao.com/en/article/curacao/, read 2026-08-30. The designated portal publishes the travel, passport, contact and personal information groups; exact passport matching with no nicknames; a flight-number lookup; and the email, date-of-birth and passport fields used to retrieve a submission. The live form does not publish readable regexes, maxlengths or validation messages. No pattern below is claimed as an official DI Card rule.

arrival_date.label: Arrival date
arrival_date.help: Complete the card within seven days before departure. A card remains active for at least one day after the initial arrival date if a flight is missed or cancelled.

flight_number.label: Flight number
flight_number.help: The official FAQ says entering the flight number displays active carriers and the corresponding port of embarkation.

passport.label: Passport information
passport.help: Passport upload is optional, but all required passport fields must match the passport carried for entry.

name.label: Name as shown in passport
name.help: The official FAQ says passport information must be entered as shown in the passport and nicknames are not allowed.

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: Date of birth is one of the fields the portal uses to retrieve a submitted card. No public format rule is published.

email.label: Email address
email.help: The confirmation PDF is emailed here. A parent or guardian should use their own email for a child.

contact_information.label: Contact information
contact_information.help: The official application process lists contact information as a required group after travel and passport information.
